title: Shared Genetic and Regulatory Architecture of Congenital Heart Disease and Autism Spectrum Disorder Revealed by Cross-Tissue Multi-Omic Integration.
authors: Zhu, Min; Zhang, Jingkun Fred; Hu, Stella X; Wang, Xuechen; Xu, Weize
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学整合与机器学习分析CHD与ASD共享遗传调控，虽涉及转录因子CHD7/MEF2C，但核心是疾病关联与表达调控，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Background: Congenital heart disease (CHD) and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) co-occur more frequently than expected, suggesting shared developmental susceptibility. We aimed to identify cross-tissue molecular candidates linking cardiac and neurodevelopmental abnormalities. Methods: CHD- and ASD-associated genes were curated from MalaCards and SFARI Gene, and their intersection was defined as the CHD- and ASD-associated gene set (CAGES). Shared gene enrichment was assessed against the human protein-coding genome. CHD and ASD genome-wide association data were integrated with heart and brain cis-expression quantitative trait loci using Bayesian colocalization and summary data-based Mendelian randomization with HEIDI testing. Candidates were further evaluated using bulk transcriptomics, six machine learning feature selection methods, independent cohorts, and scTenifoldKnk virtual knockout analyses in developing human heart and cerebral cortex. Results: Seventy-three genes were shared between CHD and ASD. CHD7 showed suggestive colocalization for CHD and ASD, while lower genetically predicted CHD7 expression was associated with higher odds of both disorders, with nonsignificant HEIDI tests. MEF2C was downregulated in tetralogy of Fallot myocardium and selected by all six ASD machine learning methods, with consistently lower expression in ASD. CAGES-derived signatures discriminated independent CHD, ASD cord blood, and cortical cohorts. CHD7 virtual knockout analysis identified MEF2C as a computationally predicted regulatory candidate in the prenatal brain, particularly in late-fetal excitatory neurons and intermediate progenitor cells, with cell-type-specific predicted effects also observed in the developing heart. Conclusions: CHD and ASD share molecular susceptibility involving pleiotropic developmental mechanisms. CHD7 and MEF2C emerge as connected cross-tissue candidates across complementary genetically informed, transcriptomic, and developmental regulatory analyses, highlighting prenatal neuronal populations and developmental windows for investigating the heart-brain axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：先天性心脏病（CHD）与自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的共现频率高于预期，提示两者存在共享的发育易感性。我们旨在识别连接心脏与神经发育异常的跨组织分子候选因子。方法：从MalaCards和SFARI Gene中筛选CHD和ASD相关基因，并将其交集定义为CHD与ASD相关基因集（CAGES）。针对人类蛋白质编码基因组评估共享基因的富集情况。利用贝叶斯共定位和基于汇总数据的孟德尔随机化（结合HEIDI检验），将CHD和ASD的全基因组关联数据与心脏和脑组织的顺式表达数量性状位点进行整合。候选因子进一步通过批量转录组学、六种机器学习特征选择方法、独立队列以及发育中人类心脏和大脑皮层的scTenifoldKnk虚拟敲除分析进行评估。结果：CHD和ASD之间共享73个基因。CHD7在CHD和ASD中显示出提示性共定位，而遗传预测的CHD7表达较低与两种疾病风险增加相关，且HEIDI检验结果不显著。MEF2C在法洛四联症心肌中表达下调，并被所有六种ASD机器学习方法选中，且在ASD中表达持续较低。CAGES衍生的特征可区分独立的CHD、ASD脐带血和皮层队列。CHD7虚拟敲除分析将MEF2C识别为产前大脑中计算预测的调控候选因子，尤其是在晚期胎儿兴奋性神经元和中间祖细胞中，同时在发育中的心脏中也观察到细胞类型特异性的预测效应。结论：CHD和ASD共享涉及多效性发育机制的分子易感性。CHD7和MEF2C在互补的遗传信息、转录组学和发育调控分析中成为相连的跨组织候选因子，突显了产前神经元群体和发育窗口，为研究心脏-大脑轴提供了线索。
